profile.summary: Brand designer with seven years of identity, packaging and campaign work for food, outdoor and arts clients. I like small teams, tight briefs and print jobs where the paper matters as much as the screen.

descriptions: Lead identity and packaging projects for 10 to 12 clients a year, from first workshop to final files

Mentor two junior designers and run the weekly critique
Designed campaigns, social graphics and print pieces for 20 small businesses and nonprofits
Handled prepress and press checks for about 40 print jobs a year
Built animated social templates in After Effects that clients could update themselves
Designed in-store signs and email headers for the summer sale season
